canonical.behaviour: Same verified change as offers #1 and #2 (blast-radius method, recipe and routing pointers, Unslop check). Live runs L1 and L2 failed. Both times a plain "what could this break?" never loaded the method, because no skill description names impact questions. This revision adds one routing fix. code-review's description (SKILL.md and agents/openai.yaml) says it also answers "what could this change break?" for a diff, a symbol or a planned change. One new line in code-review sends such a question to BLAST-RADIUS.md alone, report only, with no diff review. Its test is written first, and a fresh subagent reviews it. Then one live run L3 with your real settings (cap $3, no retries) asks the same fixture the same question. It passes when (P1) it reports only, the fixture is unchanged and no records are written, (P2) it reads skills/code-review/BLAST-RADIUS.md, (P3) the report has safety facts with their ladder step, Risks with file:line, Cleared and Before you merge, and (P4) it names the separate player.py display path. Only if L3 passes: one commit on main of the offer paths and this task's records, then a push to origin/main. If it fails, nothing is committed and I report what failed.
